why: Every behaviour check (1–3) runs the binary, so must_not item 2 is avoided. Item 1 is broken, though. Check 3's PASS condition requires that "stderr names missing.jsonl". Expect line 3 only asks for an "error on stderr", so an unreadable-file error that doesn't name the file would meet the line but fail the check. That is a stderr-content rule stricter than the line. Check 4 is also stricter than it needs to be. It requires "no change to the lint function (empty diff)" of the whole src/index.js file, while line 4 only says lint(text) is unchanged, so any other edit to that file would fail. The builder brief's exact stderr message is a build step, not a PASS/FAIL condition, so it doesn't count against item 1. The verifier's stderr requirement does, so the criterion fails.
